record.reason: The full text manages a fixed KV cache for autoregressive video diffusion, using sink/recent/memory regions and retrieval/alignment to improve long-rollout video quality. It is a real cache-management technique but operates on diffusion video latent frames, not LLM/VLM token KV caches, and its results emphasize quality rather than LLM serving efficiency; the lineage tie is weak and transferability unresolved.
record.title: TetherCache: Stabilizing Autoregressive Long-Form Video Generation with Gated Recall and Trusted Alignment
